before.zh: 1854年，霍乱再次扑进伦敦南部的街道。对在伦敦行医的约翰·斯诺来说，这既是灾难，也是一个他等了很久的机会：他已经讲了五年霍乱经水传播的主张，却始终缺一份决定性的证据。他写下的决心很直白——不遗余力查清水源对疫情的确切影响，而且要亲手来做，好把这个学说的真伪一次问清楚。
before.en: When cholera struck south London again in 1854, John Snow saw both a disaster and an opportunity he had long been waiting for. He had spent five years arguing that cholera spread through water, and for five years he had lacked a clinching piece of evidence. His resolve, as he wrote it down, was blunt: he would spare no exertion to ascertain the exact effect of the water supply on the progress of the epidemic, and he would do the work himself, so that the truth or fallacy of the doctrine would be settled in one decisive test.

before.zh: 难在怎样把“水”从空气、地段、贫富这些说不清的东西里择出来。巧的是，伦敦南部有一样东西替他准备好了对照：两家自来水公司的水管同时铺进每一条街、几乎每一条巷子，有的房子接这一家，有的接那一家，由当年的房主或住户决定。挨着门的两户人家，喝的未必是同一种水。
before.en: The difficulty was to prise water apart from air, neighborhood and poverty — the sorts of thing people blamed and nobody could measure. South London happened to hand him a ready-made comparison. The pipes of each company went down all the streets, and into nearly all the courts and alleys; a few houses were supplied by one company and a few by the other, according to the decision of the owner or occupier at that time. Two households sharing a doorstep might be drinking entirely different water.

after.zh: 1854年7月，霍乱又回到了伦敦。约翰·斯诺为一种学说辩护已经五年，这一次他写下的决心很直白：不惜一切力气，弄清供水对疫情进程的确切影响；地点选在“一切条件都如此恰好适合这项调查”的街区；而且要亲自去查，因为他要的是“最令人满意的证明”，来检验这个学说究竟是对还是错。
after.en: In July 1854 cholera came back to London. John Snow had been advocating a doctrine for five years, and this time he wrote down his resolve without ornament. He would "spare no exertion which might be necessary to ascertain the exact effect of the water supply on the progress of the epidemic", in places where "all the circumstances were so happily adapted for the inquiry". And he would do the work himself, because he wanted "the most satisfactory proof of the truth or fallacy of the doctrine which I had been advocating for five years."

after.zh: 他看中的是伦敦南部的一片街区。那里有两家自来水公司，水管各自铺进所有街道，几乎深入每一条巷子和院落；哪栋房子接哪一家，是当年两家公司激烈竞争时由房主或住户定下的。结果，很多房子的水和左右两边的邻居都不一样。斯诺看到的，是一场没有人安排、却已经摆在眼前的对照。
after.en: What he had in view was a stretch of south London served by two water companies. "The pipes of each Company go down all the streets, and into nearly all the courts and alleys." Which company a house took had been settled by the owner or occupier back "when the Water Companies were in active competition", and, as Snow put it, "In many cases a single house has a supply different from that on either side." Nobody had arranged a comparison, yet one was already laid out in front of him.

before.zh: 事情得从1852年说起。那一年，兰贝斯自来水公司把水厂迁到泰晤士迪顿，在伦敦上游取水，于是得到一份不含伦敦污水的供水；另一家南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司仍在下游取水。在两家混供的地区，两家公司的管道都下到每条街，同时走。
before.en: The story starts in 1852. That year the Lambeth Waterworks Company moved its works to Thames Ditton and began drawing from the river above London, thereby obtaining a supply of water quite free from the sewage of London. The other supplier in the area, the Southwark and Vauxhall Company, still drew its water from the tideway below the city. Where the two supplies overlapped, the mains of both companies ran down every street together.

before.zh: 斯诺把这称为一场“实验”，而且是规模最大的一场：不少于三十万人，不分性别、年龄、职业与身份，从体面人家到最穷的人，在多数情形下既不知情也无选择地被分成两组——一组的水里混着伦敦的污水，其中还可能夹带来自霍乱病人的一切；另一组的水不含这类污物。他在文中用了「without their choice, and, in most cases, without their knowledge」这样的说法，强调两组不是谁安排的。
before.en: Snow called this an experiment, and one on the grandest scale. "No fewer than three hundred thousand people of both Sexes, of every age and occupation, and of every rank and station, from gentlefolks down to the very poor, were divided into two groups without their choice, and, in most cases, without their knowledge" — one group drinking water mixed with the sewage of London, and with it whatever might have come from cholera patients, the other drinking water free of such impurity.

before.zh: 作者推断，这个格局对斯诺格外有吸引力，是因为两组人住在同一座城市、经历同一场疫情、呼吸同样的空气、走同样的街道，最大的稳定差别只剩下水。不过这是作者的解释；斯诺本人只说这里的条件“恰好适合这项调查”。
before.en: The author infers that this arrangement appealed to Snow precisely because both groups lived in one city, weathered one epidemic, breathed the same air and walked the same streets, so that the largest stable difference left standing was the water. That is the author's reading, however. Snow himself said only that he chose these places because "all the circumstances were so happily adapted for the inquiry".

after.zh: 先看水从哪里来。1832年到1849年间，伦敦的供水变动很多：南华克公司与南伦敦公司合并，成立南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司，撤掉伦敦桥的水厂，改从沃克斯霍尔桥上游约半英里、巴特西原野一带的泰晤士河取水；兰贝斯公司则一直在亨格福德市场对面取水。
after.en: Start with where the water came from. Between 1832 and 1849 London's supply changed a good deal. The Southwark Water Company merged with the South London Water Company to form the Southwark and Vauxhall Company; the works at London Bridge were abolished, and the new company drew from the Thames at Battersea Fields, about half a mile above Vauxhall Bridge. The Lambeth Company went on taking its water opposite Hungerford Market.

after.zh: 从1849年下半年到1853年8月，伦敦没有霍乱。就在这段间隙里，兰贝斯公司把水厂从亨格福德市场对面迁到泰晤士迪顿，于是得到一份“完全不含伦敦污水”的水。迁址的年份，斯诺在一条脚注里专门纠正过巴利医生：巴利以为兰贝斯公司1849年就已在泰晤士迪顿取水，其实到1852年才迁过去。在两家混供的地区，南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司的管道依旧和兰贝斯的管道一起铺在每一条街上。
after.en: London was free of cholera from the latter part of 1849 to August 1853. In that interval the Lambeth Company moved its works from opposite Hungerford Market to Thames Ditton, "thus obtaining a supply of water quite free from the sewage of London." Snow was careful about the date. In a footnote he corrected Dr Baly, who had supposed that the Lambeth Company was already drawing from Thames Ditton in 1849; the move, Snow pointed out, did not happen until 1852. Where the two supplies were mixed, the Southwark and Vauxhall pipes still ran down every street alongside Lambeth's.

after.zh: 在斯诺看来，这个格局再理想不过。两家公司都给富人也给穷人供水，大房子小房子都有；他断言，接这家水和接那家水的人，在房屋、人口和周围的一切物质条件上都没有任何差别，因此想不出比这更能彻底检验供水作用的实验——它是环境“现成摆在观察者面前”的。规模也大得惊人：不少于三十万人，不分男女老幼、职业身份，从体面人家到赤贫者，在没有选择、多数也不知情的情况下分成了两组：一组的水里有伦敦的污水，以及霍乱病人排出的任何东西；另一组的水没有这类污物。
after.en: To Snow the arrangement could hardly have been better. "Each Company supplies both rich and poor, both large houses and small", he wrote, and since there was "no difference whatever" in the houses, the people or their physical surroundings, no experiment could have been devised that would more thoroughly test the effect of water supply on cholera "than this, which circumstances placed ready made before the observer." It was enormous, too: "No fewer than three hundred thousand people of both Sexes, of every age and occupation, and of every rank and station, from gentlefolks down to the very poor, were divided into two groups without their choice, and, in most cases, without their knowledge" — one group drinking water that carried the sewage of London and whatever had come from cholera patients, the other water free of it.

before.zh: 1854年疫情一来，斯诺没有等官方统计。他的原话是，决心不遗余力弄清水源对疫情进程的确切影响，并且想自己动手调查，为的是拿到“最令人满意的证明”，来检验他倡导了五年的学说究竟成立还是落空。换句话说，这是一场他主动押上自己信誉的检验，而不是一次例行登记。
before.en: Cholera returned in 1854, and Snow did not wait for official statistics. In his own words, "I resolved to spare no exertion which might be necessary to ascertain the exact effect of the water supply on the progress of the epidemic", and he wanted to conduct the inquiry himself in order to obtain "the most satisfactory proof of the truth or fallacy of the doctrine which I had been advocating for five years." This was a test he staked his standing on, not routine registration.

before.zh: 调查落在两家公司供水交错的街区。管道各自通向所有街道，几乎深入每一条小巷和院落；有的房子由一家供，有的由另一家供，取决于当年房主或住户的决定。这里的“当年”很关键：分组不是疫情开始后现分的，而是早已在房契、水费和接水管的旧决定里定好了。
before.en: The inquiry covered the streets where the two supplies were interleaved. Each company's mains ran down all the streets and into nearly all the courts and alleys; some houses took one company's water and some the other's, according to the decision of the owner or occupier at that time. That phrase — at that time — carries the point. The grouping was not invented once the epidemic began; it had been settled years earlier in deeds, water rates and plumbing, then largely forgotten.

before.zh: 在他笔下，这场实验的规模无与伦比：不少于三十万人，男女老幼、各行各业、从绅士到赤贫者，被分成两组，且不经他们选择、多数情形下也不为他们所知；一组的水含有伦敦的污水，另一组的水完全没有这类杂质。这是他眼中最干净的对照——两组人都不知道自己正在被比较。
before.en: In Snow's telling, the experiment stood unmatched in scale. No fewer than three hundred thousand people of every sex, age, occupation and rank — from gentlefolks down to the very poor — fell into one of two groups without their choice and, in most cases, without their knowledge: one group drinking water containing the sewage of London, the other drinking water free of such impurity. This was the cleanest comparison he could imagine, because neither group knew it was being compared.

before.zh: 麻烦出在归类。很少有住户能立刻答出自家用哪家的水；即使水费由住户自己付，他们通常也要翻出收据才想得起公司名字。至于按周交租的工人，水费一律由房东或其代理人缴纳，房东往往住在别处，住户对此一无所知。换句话说，最穷的那部分人，恰恰最难说清自己喝的是哪条河的水，而他们又最经不起霍乱。
before.en: The trouble was classification. Very few households could name their water company on the spot; even residents who paid the water rates themselves usually had to dig out a receipt before the name came back to them. Among working people who paid weekly rents, the rates were invariably paid by the landlord or his agent, often living at a distance, and the residents knew nothing about the matter. In other words, the poorest — least able to survive cholera — were exactly those least able to say which stretch of river their water came from.

before.zh: 斯诺用化学检验补记忆的缺口。他采用的检验方法，建立在两种水中氯化钠含量的巨大差别之上：通过测盐，他能判断一户用的是哪一家的水，而不必只靠住户的回忆。方法很土，但在1854年的街道上，这比挨家挨户写信问房东要快得多。
before.en: Snow filled the gaps in memory with chemistry. "The test I employed was founded on the great difference in the quantity of chloride of sodium contained in the two kinds of water" — common salt, in plain terms. Measuring it let him identify a house's supplier without depending on the occupant's recollection. The method was homespun, but on the streets of 1854 it beat writing round to landlords.

before.zh: 头七周的结果写在一张表里。按每万户死亡数计，南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水户为315，兰贝斯公司供水户为37，伦敦其余地区为59。斯诺的结论是，前者的死亡率是后者的八到九倍。三个数字放在一起，差距不需要统计学也看得见。
before.en: The results of the first seven weeks went into a single table. Per ten thousand houses, deaths from cholera ran at 315 in the population supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company, 37 among Lambeth Company customers, and 59 in the rest of London. Snow's verdict: "The mortality in the houses supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company was therefore between eight and nine times as great as in the houses supplied by the Lambeth Company". Set the three numbers side by side and the gap needs no statistics to be seen.

before.zh: 作者推断，这组对比之所以刺眼，不只是因为315远大于37，还因为“伦敦其余地区”的59正落在两者之间：同处一城、同一场霍乱，唯有水源不同的一组人，死亡率高出数倍。如果杀人的是地段或空气，两组不该分得这么开。这层推理是作者补的，斯诺本人的论证集中在水质差异与死亡率的对应上。
before.en: The author infers that the comparison bites not only because 315 dwarfs 37, but because the rest of London's 59 lands squarely between them: one city, one epidemic, and the group whose only difference was its water dying at several times the rate. If the neighborhood or the air were doing the killing, the two groups should not have split so far apart. That layer of reasoning is the author's addition; Snow's own argument turned on the correspondence between water quality and death rates.

after.zh: 他并不是一开始就看清了这一点。斯诺承认，前一年年底白天短，他抽不出时间去查；而且那时他也没有充分意识到两家公司的供水混得这么密，因而没意识到这项调查有多重要。要把这场“大实验”用起来，需要的其实只有一件事：查清每一栋发生霍乱死亡的房子，用的是哪家的水。
after.en: He had not seen all this at once. Snow admitted that in the short days at the end of the previous year he "could not spare the time to make the inquiry", and that he had not then been fully aware of how intimately the two supplies were mixed, nor therefore how much the inquiry mattered. To turn the experiment to account, one thing alone was needed: "to learn the supply of water to each individual house where a fatal attack of cholera might occur."

after.zh: 1854年，他从一份名单入手。他向登记总署申请，拿到了两家公司混供地区霍乱死者的住址：一部分刊登在每周公报上，其余的获准抄录。8月中旬，他先查兰贝斯的两个分区——肯宁顿第一区和第二区。到8月12日，这两个分区共死亡44人；他查出其中38户由南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水，4户由兰贝斯公司供水，另有2户用自家院里的水井，不接任何一家公司的水。
after.en: In 1854 he started from a list. He asked the General Register Office for the addresses of people who had died of cholera in the districts where the two supplies were intermingled; some had been printed in the Weekly Returns, and he was allowed to copy the rest. About the middle of August he began with two sub-districts of Lambeth, Kennington first part and Kennington second part. There had been 44 deaths there down to 12 August. Of the houses where they occurred, he found 38 supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company, 4 by the Lambeth Company, and 2 with pump-wells on the premises and no company supply at all.

after.zh: 他一弄清这些数字，就告诉了法尔医生（Dr. Farr）。斯诺记下法尔对结果“深受触动”，并在法尔的建议下，伦敦南部各区的登记员被要求在每一例霍乱死亡中登记发病所在房屋的供水。这项规定从8月26日以后才执行，所以斯诺决定把自己的调查一直做到这一天，好让整场疫情的事实都有据可查。一个人在街上查出的苗头，就这样变成了官方登记里的一栏。
after.en: As soon as he had these particulars he passed them to Dr Farr, who, Snow wrote, "was much struck with the result". At Farr's suggestion the registrars of all the south districts of London were asked to return the water supply of the house in every fatal case. The order took effect only after 26 August, so Snow resolved to carry his own inquiry down to that date, "so that the facts might be ascertained for the whole course of the epidemic." What one man had found on the street became a column in the official returns.

after.zh: 他把调查扩展到兰贝斯、南华克和纽因顿其他混供的分区，结果与肯宁顿“非常相似”。有些病人发病后被送进济贫院或别处，他就去查发病时所住那栋房子的水，而不是死在哪里。
after.en: He carried the inquiry over the other intermixed sub-districts of Lambeth, Southwark and Newington, "with a result very similar to that already given". Where a patient had been moved to a workhouse or anywhere else after the attack began, he asked about the water of the house where the person had been living when it started, not the place where they died.

after.zh: 麻烦出在归类。很少有人家能当场答出自家用哪家公司的水；就算水费是住户自己交，他们通常也得翻出收据才想得起公司名字。按周交房租的工人家庭更难：水费一律由房东或其代理人缴纳，房东往往住得很远，住户对此一无所知。斯诺写道，要不是发现能用化学检验把两家的水确定无疑地分开，这项调查几乎不可能完成。
after.en: The hard part was classification. Very few households could name their water company on the spot: "Even when the water-rates are paid by the residents, they can seldom remember the name of the Water Company till they have looked for the receipt." For working families who paid weekly rents it was worse. The rates were paid by the landlord or his agent, who often lived at a distance, "and the residents know nothing about the matter." Snow wrote that it would have been almost impossible to finish the inquiry had he not found that a chemical test could tell the two waters apart with certainty.

after.zh: 检验靠的是两种水里氯化钠——也就是食盐——含量的巨大差别。往水里加硝酸银，两家的水反应差得很远，一眼就能分辨。住户说不清时，他就用小瓶装一点水，在瓶盖上写下地址，回家再验。他也看水的样子，尤其是刚流进来、还没进水桶或水箱的时候；他还摸清了两家公司的放水工各在几点到哪条街，水来的时辰也能透露是哪家的水。不过这些只用来佐证更确凿的证据，不单独作数。
after.en: "The test I employed was founded on the great difference in the quantity of chloride of sodium contained in the two kinds of water" — common salt. Add nitrate of silver and the two waters looked so different that they "could be at once distinguished without any further trouble." When a resident could not say for certain, Snow put some water in a small phial, wrote the address on the cover and examined it at home. He looked at the water itself, especially as it came in, before it reached the butt or cistern; and once he had learned the hours when each company's turncocks visited a street, the time the water arrived told him something too. These signs he used only to corroborate more decisive proof, never on their own.

after.zh: 疫情头七周的结果，他整理成一张表。南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水40,046户，霍乱死亡1,263人；兰贝斯公司供水26,107户，死亡98人；伦敦其余地区256,423户，死亡1,422人。折算成每10,000户的死亡数，分别是315、37和59。他的结论是，前者的死亡率是后者的八到九倍。
after.en: The first seven weeks of the epidemic went into a single table. Houses supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company: 40,046, with 1,263 deaths from cholera. Lambeth Company: 26,107 houses, 98 deaths. The rest of London: 256,423 houses, 1,422 deaths. Per 10,000 houses that came to 315, 37 and 59. Snow's conclusion: "The mortality in the houses supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company was therefore between eight and nine times as great as in the houses supplied by the Lambeth Company".

after.zh: 作者的解读：两组数字方向一致。肯宁顿的38户对4户，来自同一片混供街区；表里的315对37，覆盖两家公司的全部供水户，而伦敦其余地区的59恰好落在两者之间。接兰贝斯水的人家，死亡率比全城其余地方还低；接南华克和沃克斯霍尔水的人家，高出好几倍。如果是街区或空气在起作用，同一片街区里的两组人家不该分得这么开。这层推理是作者补的；斯诺本人的论证集中在供水与死亡的对应上。
after.en: The author's reading: the two sets of figures point the same way. Kennington's 38 houses against 4 came from the same intermixed streets; the table's 315 against 37 covers every house each company supplied, with the rest of London's 59 falling between them. Houses on Lambeth water died at a lower rate than the rest of the city, houses on Southwark and Vauxhall water at several times it. If the neighbourhood or the air were doing the killing, two sets of houses in the same streets should not have split so far apart. That step is the author's; Snow's own argument rested on the correspondence between the water and the deaths.

before.zh: 这个设计的说服力来自“并行”：两套管道像两条平行线，落在几乎相同的居民身上，谁也没有为了做实验而改变什么。房主当年选哪家，多半只是签水费时的随手决定；到1854年，这个早已忘记的理由，成了两组人之间最大的差别。一种解释是，正因为没有人刻意安排，结果才不容易被“有人想证明什么”污染。
before.en: The design earns its force from parallelism: two sets of pipes running like parallel lines across nearly identical populations, with nothing altered for the sake of an experiment. Whichever company a householder had picked was mostly a shrug at the moment of signing up. By 1854 that long-forgotten whim had become the largest difference between the two groups. One reading is that precisely because nobody arranged the split, the result is hard to spoil with anyone's wish to prove something.

before.zh: 作者提出的另一种做法（此处是作者提出的替代选择，非史料）：如果斯诺只比较整个伦敦的平均死亡率，或者只比较富区与穷区，贫富、住房、职业都会混进来，水的作用会被冲淡。而这条街上“一墙之隔、两种水”的格局，把无关因素压到了最低。斯诺等的不是更完美的数据，而是一个已经存在的对照——他要做的是把它挖出来、核清楚。
before.en: The author sketches a counterfactual — an alternative design, not history. Had Snow compared London's average death rate, or a rich district against a poor one, wealth, housing and occupation would have crowded in and diluted the effect of water. The street-by-street pattern of two supplies running down the same road pressed those extraneous factors to a minimum. Snow was not waiting for more perfect data; he was waiting for a comparison that already existed, and what remained was to dig it out and check it.

after.zh: 一种解释是，这项调查的说服力来自“并行”：两套管道铺在同样的街道上，分组早在两家公司竞争的时候就定下了，没有人为了做实验去改变什么，也就很难说结果是被谁的愿望安排出来的。斯诺本人强调的正是这一点：两组人没有选择，多数也不知情。
after.en: One reading is that the inquiry draws its force from running in parallel. Two sets of pipes lay along the same streets; the split had been fixed back when the companies were competing, and nobody altered anything to make an experiment, so it is hard to say the result was arranged by anyone's wishes. That is the point Snow himself pressed: the two groups were divided "without their choice" and mostly without their knowledge.

after.zh: 另一种做法（作者设想的替代方案，不是史实）：只比较各区的平均死亡率，或者拿富区和穷区对比。那样贫富、住房、职业都会混进来，水的作用就分不清了。斯诺选了更费事的路——挨家查死者住址、查水、必要时装瓶回家化验——换来的是在同一批街道里比较两种水。
after.en: Another approach, and this is the author's counterfactual rather than history, would have been to compare average death rates by district, or rich districts against poor ones. Wealth, housing and occupation would then have crowded in, and the effect of the water would have been hard to separate out. Snow took the more laborious road — death addresses, house by house, water carried home in phials — and in return got a comparison of two waters within the same streets.

after.zh: 还有一点容易被忽略（作者的解读）：斯诺没有等调查全部做完才开口。他在肯宁顿查出头一批数字，就交给了法尔；登记办法随之改变，此后每一例死亡都要记下供水。早期的结果先被用来改进收集证据的办法。
after.en: One more point is easy to miss, and it is the author's reading. Snow did not wait for the inquiry to be finished before speaking. Once he had the first figures from Kennington he passed them to Farr, the registration practice changed, and from then on every death came with its water supply recorded. The early result went first into improving how the evidence was gathered.

before.zh: 现代虚构场景一：某家公司有两个客服小组，因为系统迁移的遗留问题，同一个星期里用两种话术处理同一批来电。没人安排实验，也没人愿意等半年再上新流程。带队的人于是把两个小组的同一类工单拉出来比：同样的话，一组回头率低得多。他不必证明哪套话术在所有情况下都好，只需要决定这周先把哪套铺开。
before.en: Fictional modern scene one. A company finds two customer-service teams handling the same week's calls with different scripts, a leftover of a system migration. Nobody designed an experiment, and nobody wants to wait six months before rolling out a new process. So the team lead pulls the same class of tickets from both groups and compares: the same kinds of questions, and one group's callback rate is far lower. He need not prove that this script wins in every situation; he only has to decide which one to roll out this week.

before.zh: 现代虚构场景二：一栋公寓楼里，两家网络公司同时布了线，租客签合同时随手选了一家。半年后楼里有人抱怨视频会议老掉线，物业没有挨户发问卷，只是找出掉线报修集中在哪几户，再对照他们接的是哪家的线——同楼、同电梯、同一天的雨，剩下的差别就只有线路。
before.en: Fictional modern scene two. In an apartment block, two internet providers ran cabling at the same time, and tenants picked one almost at random when signing the lease. Six months on, residents complain that video calls keep dropping. The property manager sends no questionnaire round the flats; he simply maps which households log the faults and checks which provider's line they are on. Same building, same lifts, same rain — and the only difference left is the wire.

after.zh: 现代虚构场景一：一家连锁药店的区域主管发现，几家门店的退货投诉似乎集中在同一批货上，手里只有几十条记录。这位主管没有急着宣布结论，而是先把记录交给总部的数据组，请他们在所有门店的退货单上加一栏“批次号”。两周后，答案不再取决于一个人能问到多少家店。
after.en: Fictional modern scene one. A regional manager at a pharmacy chain notices that returns at a few branches seem to cluster on one batch of stock, with only a few dozen records to go on. Instead of announcing a finding, the manager hands the records to head office's data team and asks for a "batch number" field on every return slip in every branch. Two weeks later, the answer no longer depends on how many shops one person can visit.

after.zh: 现代虚构场景二：一栋公寓楼里，两家网络公司同时布了线，租客签合同时各选了一家，很多人早忘了自己选的是哪家。半年后楼里有人抱怨视频会议老掉线。物业没有挨户发问卷，而是去查每户墙上的接线盒到底接的是哪家的线，再对照报修记录——同楼、同电梯、同一天的雨，剩下的差别就只有线路。
after.en: Fictional modern scene two. Two internet providers cabled an apartment block at the same time, and tenants chose one or the other when they signed their leases; many have long forgotten which. Six months on, residents complain that video calls keep dropping. The property manager sends round no questionnaire. Instead, the manager checks which provider's line each flat's wall box is actually connected to, and lays that against the fault reports. Same building, same lifts, same rain — the only difference left is the wire.

before.zh: 必须说清楚：本篇所有数字与叙述都出自斯诺本人的著作与统计，当时没有卫生部门或第三方的独立核查。一位研究者既是提出学说的人，又是调查者和统计者，这不意味着数据错了，但意味着我们读到的是单方记录。
before.en: Plainly: every figure and every account in this piece comes from Snow's own book and his own tables, with no independent check by a health authority or any third party at the time. When the same man proposes the doctrine, conducts the inquiry and compiles the statistics, that does not make the data wrong — but it does mean we are reading one side's record.

before.zh: 其次，“现成的实验”是斯诺自己的论证框架，不是严格的随机分组：房主或住户选哪家公司并非抽签，可能与房租高低、房屋新旧、地段有关（此关联为作者推测，史料只记录了由房主或住户决定，以及按周交租的工人由远方的房东缴费）。把两组视为可比，靠的是“同街同疫”的近似，而不是随机化本身。
before.en: Second, the ready-made experiment is Snow's own argumentative framing, not strict randomization. The owner's or occupier's choice of company was no lottery draw, and may have tracked rent levels, the age of the house or the address (that link is the author's speculation; the record notes only that the decision rested with the owner or occupier, and that for weekly tenants the rates were paid by a landlord or agent living at a distance). Treating the two groups as comparable rests on the approximation of the same street and the same epidemic, not on randomization itself.

before.en: Finally, this piece works from OCR text of a scanned copy, and some figures in the original are already garbled nearby. Only three legible numbers from the table are used here — 315, 37 and 59 — together with the conclusion of "between eight and nine times". No other ratios or breakdowns are cited.

after.en: Plainly: every figure and every account in this piece comes from Snow's own book and his own tables, and the evidence used here contains no independent check by a health authority or anyone else at the time. When the same man proposes the doctrine, conducts the inquiry and compiles the statistics, that does not make the data wrong, but it does mean we are reading one side's record.

after.zh: 其次，“两组人没有任何差别”是斯诺的断言，不是随机分组的结果。哪栋房子接哪家水，由当年的房主或住户决定，并非抽签；这种选择会不会和房租、房龄、地段有关，本篇的证据无法回答，这是作者提出的疑问。斯诺自己的调查也显示，按周交租的工人家庭连水费由谁交都不清楚——“选择”往往不在喝水的人手里。
after.en: Second, "no difference whatever" between the groups is Snow's assertion, not the product of random assignment. Which company a house took was decided by the owner or occupier, not drawn by lot; whether that choice tracked rents, the age of the houses or their location is a question the evidence here cannot answer, and it is the author's question, not Snow's. His own inquiry shows that working families on weekly rents did not even know who paid their water rates. The choice was often not in the hands of the people drinking the water.
